==About==

A {{i|Ladybug}} is rarely received when Releasing a {{i|Bug in a Blanket}}, or when Dissecting {{i|Frog}}s and {{i|Toad}}s. A Ladybug Test is a minor [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Slugs Bugs and Kritters}} Food Group.
restores|
==Ladybug As a Variable Ingredient==

When used as a variable ingredient in recipes a {{i|Ladybug}} gives a Restore [[:Category:Variable Food#Bonus Values|Bonus]].
